channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: T20 WC: SA batters will face stern examination against Bumrah and Chakaravarthy, says Peterson
item.description: South Africa's batters face a formidable examination against Jasprit Bumrah and Varun Chakaravarthy when they take on India in a blockbuster Super Eights clash of Men’s T20 World Cup at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday evening, said former all-rounder Robin Peterson.

item.title: Eight linked to Pakistan arrested in TN, Bengal for terror plotting against India
item.description: A total of eight people, linked to Pakistan's intelligence agency ISI and Bangladeshi terror outfits, have been arrested in connection with plotting a terror conspiracy against India, officials said on Sunday.

item.title: Creators of Tomorrow – Buildathon 2026 Grand Finale Held in Hyderabad
item.description: CVR College of Engineering emerged as the overall winner for its innovative project titled “Water Treatment Waste into Sustainable Building Solutions.” The team received a cash prize of Rs 2.5 lakh for their winning idea.

item.title: ‘Mann Ki Baat’: PM Modi praises Indian-origin cricketers in foreign teams, highlights ‘speciality of Bhartiyata’
item.description: Addressing the 131st episode of his monthly radio programme, 'Mann Ki Baat', PM Modi said, "Nowadays, you must be watching T20 World Cup matches.

item.title: Golden chapter in UP development journey, says CM Yogi on new connectivity projects
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Sunday said that a "golden chapter" is about to begin in the state's development journey as Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to flag off the Meerut Metro and Namo Bharat train later in the day.

item.title: 15 Tolas of Gold Stolen from Woman’s Bag on RTC Bus in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: According to the victim and police officials, the woman, identified as Sridevi, was travelling to Kadapa via Proddatur and Kogatam. She boarded the bus at Kamalapuram. The incident reportedly took place when the bus was near the Papagni river stretch.

item.title: True progress in sport lies in inclusion: Laxman lauds BCCI’s call announcing structured support for CABI
item.description: Former India batter and current head of the National Cricket Academy (NCA) VVS Laxman lauded the BCCI's initiative of announcing structured support for the Cricket Association for the Blind in India (CABI), calling it a "wonderful step to create greater opportunities."

item.title: Topmost Maoist Devji ‘surrenders’ before Telangana Police
item.description: Sixteen Maoists also laid down their arms along with Devji, who had been leading the outfit after the killing of Nambala Keshav Rao alias Basavaraju, who was killed in an encounter with security forces in Chhattisgarh in May last year.

item.title: Mann Ki Baat: PM Modi remembers Kerala’s youngest organ donor, who gave life to others
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday mentioned the case of a ten-month-old infant from Kerala during his monthly radio programme, Mann Ki Baat.

item.title: Nifty-500 clocks highest earnings growth in 8 quarters
item.description: India Inc delivered its strongest earnings performance in the past eight quarters in the third quarter of FY26, driven by broad-based sectoral growth and improving demand trends, a new report said on Sunday.
